description:
Castlevania: Symphony of the Night (Konami, 1997), played on SymphonyRecomp, the native PC version
of the PlayStation game, with the Archipelago mod. Explore Dracula's castle as Alucard; relics and
items are shuffled across the multiworld.

0.3.0.description:
First public test build. Expect some bugs, and please open an [issue](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/issues) if you find one.

**Downloads**
- [sotn-archipelago-mod.zip](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.3.0/sotn-archipelago-mod.zip): the mod (every player)
- [sotn_recomp.apworld](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.3.0/sotn_recomp.apworld): the apworld (whoever generates)
- [Symphony-of-the-Night-Recomp.yaml](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.3.0/Symphony-of-the-Night-Recomp.yaml): default options

**You need** SymphonyRecomp v0.5.1b or newer with your own US disc image, and Archipelago 0.6.0 or newer.

**Setup**
1. Drop the mod zip into SymphonyRecomp's `mods` folder (don't unzip it), then press F1, open Mods and enable Archipelago.
2. Install the apworld (double-click it) and generate like normal.
3. In game, press F1 and go to Archipelago > Connection. Enter the server and slot, then connect.

See the [README](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago#readme) for more.

0.4.0.description:
Test build of the shuffled castle. Expect some bugs, and please open an [issue](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/issues) if you find one.

- New options to shuffle the castle, ported from Sestren's SOTN Shuffler: `shuffle_rooms` lays out each area's rooms differently, `shuffle_area_connections` changes which areas lead to which. Both are off by default. The logic, the pause map and the Map window follow the new layout.
- `map_area_colors`: with a shuffled castle, the pause map shows each area in its own colour
- With a shuffled castle, the Castle map from the Librarian shows the whole castle
- `starting_area`: sotn.io's fixes for Royal Chapel and Castle Keep starts

**Downloads**
- [sotn-archipelago-mod.zip](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.4.0/sotn-archipelago-mod.zip): goes in recomp's `/mods/` folder

0.5.0.description:
Test build of the Richter goal and traps. Expect some bugs, and please open an [issue](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/issues) if you find one. The shuffled castle from the 0.4.0 test build isn't in this one.

- New goal `defeat_richter`: a shorter game that ends by beating or saving Richter, with no inverted castle
- New traps: `trap_percentage` and `trap_types` turn some filler into Poison, Stone and Curse traps (off by default)
- New `disguise_traps` (on by default): traps look like progression items until picked up
- 25+ items arriving at once now share one popup; key items and traps keep their own
- Works with SymphonyRecomp 1.0 (also builds on v0.5.1b, but hasn't been played there yet)
- `starting_area`: sotn.io's fixes for Royal Chapel and Castle Keep starts

**Downloads**
- [sotn-archipelago-mod.zip](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.5.0/sotn-archipelago-mod.zip): goes in recomp's `/mods/` folder
